subject: Routes awarded under UDAN in Andhra Pradesh

subject: Connecting Baramati airport under UDAN scheme
question_text: (a) the current status of connecting Baramati airport to civil air traffic under the 'UDAN' scheme; (b) whether Government plans to develop 'Night Landing' facilities in Baramati and use it as an agricultural export (Krishi UDAN) hub; (c) if so, the details thereof; (d) whether there is any special financial assistance or scheme proposed for the modernization of flying training institutes located in Baramati so that local youth can get employment in the aviation sector; and (e) if so, the details thereof?

subject: Development of Rourkela airport

subject: Safety risks faced by regional and smaller airports
question_text: (a) whether Government has assessed the safety risks faced by regional and smaller airports, particularly in eastern and coastal States, due to terrain, weather conditions or infrastructure gaps; (b) if so, the steps taken to address these risks, including measures for strengthening safety audits, emergency preparedness, pilot training and operational safety standards at non-metro and regional airports; and (c) if not, the reasons therefor?

subject: Aviation safety oversight and DGCA capacity
question_text: (a) the number of safety audits, ramp inspections, and surveillance checks conducted by DGCA since January, 2025; (b) whether any recurring technical or operational deficiencies have been identified across airlines; (c) if so, the details thereof; (d) manner in which shortages of inspectors, pilots, and technical specialists within DGCA are being addressed; and (e) the steps taken to strengthen real-time monitoring and enforcement mechanisms?

subject: Performance of UDAN scheme
question_text: (a) whether UDAN scheme is being implented under various phases since last five years; (b) if so, the details thereof along with the details of fund allocated, released and utilized for providing subsidy to airliners under UDAN scheme since inception till date, year-wise; (c) the details of airports connected under UDAN scheme, so far, State-wise and year-wise; (d) the number of airports under UDAN scheme which face lack of flights or temporary closure due to low passenger demand, State-wise; and (e) the details of expenses on maintenance and security of these airports?

subject: Airfare trends, ATF pricing and impact on consumer
question_text: (a) whether Government has assessed the impact of Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) price movements on air ticket pricing and airline cost structures; (b) whether rising ATF prices have contributed to higher fares for passengers; (c) whether meetings have been held with State Governments to rationalise ATF taxation and bring it under GST; (d) if so, the details and outcomes of such discussions; (e) whether safeguards and regulatory mechanisms exist to prevent excessive or arbitrary surge in pricing by airlines during peak travel seasons; and (f) whether measures have been taken to strengthen passenger grievance redressal systems and ensure timely enforcement of refund and compensation norms?

subject: Flight cancellation due to IndiGo mismanagement
question_text: (a) provide the details that has led to recent large-scale cancellations of IndiGo flights and the resulting congestion and chaos at several airports, which caused severe inconvenience to passengers; (b) the steps that were taken by Government and the DGCA to enforce passenger rights regarding timely information, refunds, compensation, food, accommodation, and alternate arrangements; (c) whether complaints were received from affected passengers, and if so, the number thereof; and (d) whether accountability has been fixed on the airline, and regulatory measures that are being introduced to prevent such operational failures and protect passenger rights in the future?

subject: Current status of airports in the State of Maharashtra
question_text: (a) whether Government has assessed the current capacity and infrastructure constraints at major airports in the State of Maharashtra, particularly Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur and Aurangabad; (b) whether congestion, slot saturation and passenger inconvenience have been reported at these airports; (c) the details of steps taken or proposed to augment terminal capacity, runways and air traffic management systems; and (d) whether Government plans to expedite greenfield airport projects and expansion under the UDAN and other schemes to improve regional air connectivity in the State of Maharashtra and if so, the timelines fixed for completion of such projects?

subject: Safety oversight and aircraft maintenance standards
question_text: (a) the number of safety audits conducted on domestic airlines during the last two years; (b) deficiencies observed in aircraft maintenance and compliance with DGCA norms; (c) action taken against airlines for repeated safety violations; and (d) reasons for continuing incidents despite claims of strengthened oversight and whether independent safety audits will be institutionalised?

subject: Passengers traffic in top ten airports
question_text: (a) the details of top ten airports in the country in terms of handling highest number of domestic & international passenger traffic during the last three calendar years, year-wise and airport-wise; (b) the details of top ten Indian airports with highest number of cancelled domestic flights during the last three years, year-wise and airport-wise; and (c) the details of steps taken by Government to reduce ill-effects of duopoly of IndiGo and Tata’s Air India in the Indian aviation industry?

subject: India's projected share in global aviation passenger traffic and revenue
question_text: (a) whether it is a fact that according to some estimates, 5.2 billion passengers are expected to take to the skies in 2026; (b) whether it is also a fact that the global aviation industry is expected to generate USD 41 billion in net profits in 2026 with a 3.9 per cent net margin; and (c) if answers to 1 and 2 are “Yes”, what does the Ministry forecast as India’s civil aviation sector’s share in passenger traffic and passenger revenue?

subject: High airfare concerns and airline operations impacting common passengers
party_full: All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam
question_text: (a) the reasons behind frequent and steep airfare surges on domestic routes, especially during festivals, emergencies and peak seasons, causing severe hardship to common passengers; (b) whether any effective regulatory mechanism exists to prevent predatory pricing, cartelisation or algorithm-driven fare manipulation by airlines; (c) whether Government is aware of repeated complaints regarding flight delays, cancellations, overbooking and poor grievance redressal and the corrective measures that have been enforced against erring airlines; and (d) whether airlines are being permitted to reduce operational capacity while simultaneously increasing fares and the manner in which this aligns with passenger welfare obligations?

subject: UDAN scheme in Gujarat
question_text: (a) the number of locations in the State of Gujarat from where air connectivity has been started under the UDAN scheme so far, the details thereof; and (b) whether Government is aware of any instances of air services being discontinued in the State after their commencement, if so, the details thereof?

subject: User Development Fee
question_text: (a) the airports in the country where User Development Fee (UDF) is being levied on passengers at present; (b) the rate of UDF charged at each such airport, separately for domestic and international passengers; (c) the name of the operating agency managing each such airport; (d) the rates and total amount of user fee collected under UDF during each of the last five years, year-wise or revision-wise and airport-wise; and (e) the factors taken into account while revising UDF?

question_text: (a) airstrips upgraded in Western Odisha; (b) UDAN flights made operational; (c) funds released; (d) timeline for new services; and (e) socio-economic impact?

subject: Assessment of shortage of pilots

subject: Proposal for development of an airport at Hosur, Tamil Nadu
question_text: (a) whether a proposal for development of an airport at Hosur, in the State of Tamil Nadu, was submitted to the Ministry; (b) if so, the reasons for not approving or rejecting the proposal, including technical, airspace, safety, regulatory and defence-related considerations, if any; and (c) whether any alternative or revised proposal for airport development at Hosur is under examination?

subject: Safety standards and regulatory framework in Indian aviation sector
question_text: (a) status of compliance with International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) standards in aviation security standards, aircraft certification, pilot licensing, and maintenance oversight by Bureau of Civil Aviation Security (BCAS) and Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA); (b) details of the improvements observed in flight safety and operational efficiency as a result of airspace management, Air Traffic Control (ATC) modernization, expansion of radar and GAGAN; (c) current status of airport security, passenger and cargo screening, cyber-security and counter-terrorism preparedness; and (d) effectiveness of DGCA’s oversight on aircraft accident investigation, safety audits, pilot training and maintenance quality, and the outcomes of international benchmarking?

subject: Structural problems in aviation sector
question_text: (a) whether recent crisis involving IndiGo has exposed deep structural problems in aviation sector; (b) if so, the details thereof; (c) whether many UDAN routes remain commercially non-viable with airlines withdrawing after viability gap funding expires; (d) if so, the details thereof; (e) whether aviation sector regulator (DGCA) is constrained by limited autonomy, funding and manpower; and (f) if so, the steps proposed to be taken to make DGCA independent with greater resources and authority?

subject: Poor air connectivity and under-utilisation of airports in Madhya Pradesh
question_text: (a) the reasons for limited flight connectivity, low frequency of services and discontinuation of flights from airports at Gwalior and Jabalpur despite infrastructure investments of nearly ?500 crore; (b) details of flight cancellations and operational disruptions affecting passengers in Indore, Bhopal, Gwalior and Jabalpur over the last three years; (c) the impact of inadequate air connectivity on tourism, medical travel and economic activity in the State of Madhya Pradesh; and (d) the concrete measures proposed to ensure reliable airline operations and optimal utilisation of upgraded airports in the State?

subject: Housing affordability crisis in rapidly growing cities like Pune
question_text: (a) whether Government has taken note of the declining housing sales in affordable and mid-income segments in Pune during 2025 due to rising prices, outdated affordable housing caps and reduced project launches; (b) whether Government proposes to revise the definition and price threshold of affordable housing in major urban centres and extend fiscal incentives to revive supply; and (c) the steps being taken to coordinate with Government of Maharashtra for faster approvals, GST rationalisation and targeted support for first-time urban homebuyers?

subject: Revision of ground rent and outstanding dues of  Annamalai University

subject: Support to content creators

subject: Current status of Coal Land Acquisition and Management Portal
question_text: (a) the current status of implementation of the Coal Land Acquisition and Management Portal (CLAMP) since its launch; (b) the details of number of land acquisition cases on States covered on the portal; (c) the extent to which CLAMP has reduced timelines and improved transparency in the key stages of land acquisition; (d) whether any mechanisms have been put in place on the portal to address grievances of affected landowners and project-affected families; (e) if so, the number of grievances received and resolved so far; and (f) the steps being taken to integrate CLAMP with State land records and other relevant digital platforms for real-time monitoring of land acquisition processes?

question_text: (a) whether Government has conducted a review of the progress made in implementation of National Education Policy (NEP), 2020 across the country including Tamil Nadu; (b) if so, the key findings from such reviews, and how are they being addressed to ensure timely and effective implementation of policy; (c) the steps that have been taken to monitor impact of NEP on educational outcomes, especially in rural and underserved areas; (d) the initiatives that have been introduced to address challenges related to funding, infrastructure, and teacher training in line with NEP’s recommendations; and (e) whether there are any proposed amendments to NEP based on feedback from stakeholders and ongoing reviews?

subject: Women Safety at Workplace
